info.title: Overhead API
info.description: Backend API. Application endpoints return {data, error, request_id} envelopes; device endpoints follow the FlightPortrait protocol wire format.

Location.description: Full location record including private coordinates.

SignedUpload.description: Upload with PUT to signed_url (or uploadToSignedUrl).

ArtAssetUpdate.description: Use /approve and /reject to change review state.

status.description: Setting "ready" verifies the uploaded device binary (size, pixel codes) and records its sha256.

setup_secret.description: Shown once. Enter as the BYOS setup secret during frame provisioning. Only its hash is stored.

get.summary: Get the caller's profile (created on first access)

get.description: Coordinates are omitted; fetch a single location to see them.

get.summary: Get a location, including its private coordinates

delete.description: Also deletes its overflights, posters and worker state.

get.description: Filters: registration (prefix), icao24 (exact), type_code (exact), manufacturer and model (substring).

patch.description: Allowed only for aircraft you have observed. Marks metadata_source as "manual" so provider data will not overwrite registration or type.

get.description: Newest first by closest approach. Dates are local to the location. Closest-approach coordinates are omitted from lists.

get.summary: Sampled track points for an overflight
get.description: Returns private coordinates; ordered by time.
Aggregated by the security-invoker view public.hangar_aircraft, so only your own overflights count.

get.summary: Hangar entry with its most recent passes

post.summary: Create a signed upload URL for a source image
post.description: The server chooses the bucket and an owner-prefixed path. Use the returned path as storage_path.
Remote URLs are stored as metadata only; they are never fetched.

delete.summary: Delete a source image and its stored object

post.summary: Create a signed upload URL for artwork (or its thumbnail)

post.description: New assets start as draft or pending_review.

patch.description: Replacing the image of an approved asset returns it to pending_review.

delete.description: Stored objects are kept; delete them separately if unused.

post.description: Fails with storage_object_missing unless the image (and thumbnail) exist.
Rendering is not part of this phase.

get.summary: Get a poster with its items

patch.description: Setting status to "ready" downloads the uploaded device binary, verifies it is a 960,000-byte Spectra 6 panel image and records its sha256. Frames are only ever served verified binaries.

delete.summary: Delete a poster and its items

post.description: Overflights and art assets must belong to you.

post.summary: Create a signed upload URL for the frame binary
post.description: Resets the poster to draft (if ready) until the new binary is verified via PATCH status=ready.
Returns a setup secret exactly once. Enter it as the BYOS setup secret when provisioning the frame; only its SHA-256 hash is stored.

delete.description: Its credentials are deleted and its token stops working immediately.

post.summary: Issue a new setup secret (shown once)

revoke_token.description: Also invalidate the current bearer token.

post.summary: Ask the frame to factory-reset on its next wake
post.description: Delivered as reset=true in the next /device/v1/display response; cleared when the frame sets up again.

post.summary: First connected setup (FlightPortrait-compatible, pairing-free BYOS form)

200.description: Fresh bearer token (64 lowercase hex). Only its hash is stored.

401.description: Unknown MAC or wrong setup secret

get.summary: Every wake: current poster binary via short-lived signed URL

503.description: No verified poster binary is available yet; the frame backs off and retries
